decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Lord Francis Hill's spouse. Document 1 (D1) presents a factual/historical narrative stating he was married to Ishabel MacDougall, citing census data, parish registers, and historian testimony (D1S2, D1S8, D1S9). Document 2 (D2) presents a fictional narrative set in 1920 where Lord Francis Hill is explicitly described as thinking of his wife, Janet Halyburton, Lady Dirletoun (D2S4). As the prompt instructs to treat all sources as fallible and preserve distinct valid referents without assuming one document overrides the other, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the respective source contexts.
